YJDynamicImageBatchConcat.description: Concatenate image batches, trimming the specified number of frames from the start of each batch after image1.

image1.name: Image 1
image1.tooltip: First image batch; its frames are kept in full.

image2.name: Image 2
image2.tooltip: Additional image batch. Connecting it adds the next input.

减去重复帧数.name: Frames to trim
减去重复帧数.tooltip: Frames removed from the start of each batch after image1.

YJpause.description: Pauses the current workflow at this point when enabled. Continue resumes from the current state; Restart stops and queues the workflow again; Stop ends only the current job.

value.name: Value
value.tooltip: Connect any data line that should pass through this breakpoint.

enabled.name: Pause enabled
enabled.tooltip: When enabled, pause every time execution reaches this node. When disabled, pass the value through directly.

timeout_minutes.name: Auto-stop timeout (minutes)
timeout_minutes.tooltip: Automatically stop the current job after this many paused minutes. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely.
